Settings and languages
,
 Changing your language
,
Tap the server name → Channels & Roles → pick again. Your lounge and news channel follow your choice. That's the only setting here — every other channel is open to everyone.


 Reading other languages
,
Write in your own language. Nobody here has to switch languages to be understood.
Forum posts — a non-English post gets an English translation added right under it, automatically.
Anything else — right-click it (long-press on mobile) → Apps →  Translate. It answers in the language your Discord is set to, only you see it, and it works in every channel: lounges, welcome, news, forums.

Post titles aren't translated, so a short English title helps people find your post.
